purpose: Talk season stats; teach リーグ/統計/勝利/女子/予測/チャンス/唯一/復活

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 今季のリーグ、統計がすごく面白い。
lines.en: This season’s league statistics are fascinating.
lines.style: data-loving fan diving in, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: どのチームが勝利数トップ？
lines.en: Which team has the most victories?
lines.style: curious fan asking the leaderboard, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 女子リーグはうちが一位だよ。
lines.en: In the women’s league, we’re first.
lines.style: proud fan reporting the standing, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 来季の順位、予測できる？
lines.en: Can you predict next season’s ranking?
lines.style: fan inviting speculation, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 難しいな。チャンスは全チームにある。
lines.en: Hard to say. Every team has a chance.
lines.style: measured fan hedging fairly, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 唯一、絶対王者と言える存在はいないね。
lines.style: fan noting the parity, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 昨季の最下位チームの復活もあり得る。
lines.en: Last season’s bottom team could revive too.
lines.style: optimistic fan imagining an upset, voice clear and distinctly their own
